messages.subject: Results column in updated wiki table
messages.subject_clean: Results column in updated wiki table
messages.body_plain:
Dear GSOC-R students and mentors,

The GSOC coding period has officially started and I have updated the wiki table to reflect the set of students that were accepted.

https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2015/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects

I also have moved the Results column to the left so it is more visisble. Please note that this year students will be required to put their code in a public code repository (Github, R-Forge, etc), and then post a link in the Results column before the mid-term deadline, 26 June 2015.

Students, if you have already begun coding in a public repository, then you can post a link right away! If not, please start thinking about where you want to put your code, and make sure to post a link before the mid-term deadline.
